question: Who among the following is the author of ‘Set the Boy Free’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Johnny Marr.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Johnny Marr**

__
 
• The **author of Set the Boy Free is Johnny Marr.**
 
• Johnny Marr is a** musician and songwriter.**
 
• Between 1982 and 1987 he was the **co-founder of and guitarist for The Smiths.**
 
• He is now an established **solo artist who has released two albums, The Messenger and Playland, to date.**
 
• He currently** lives in Manchester, England.**
 
• The books written by **Johnny Marr are Total Chaos: The Story of the Stooges, Punk Fiction: An Anthology of Short Stories Inspired by Punk, Instrument, Strangeways - Here We Come, Lowdown: The Story of Wire, The Smiths.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****David Niven**

 
• **David Niven, PhD, is a social scientist **and **author of the 100 Simple Secrets series.**
 
• His books have **sold more than 1 million copies in the U.S.** and have been** translated into 30 languages.**
 
• His new book is** It's Not About the Shark: How to Solve Unsolvable Problems.**

**Paul Kalanithi**

 
• **Paul Sudhir Arul Kalanithi** was an **American neurosurgeon and writer.**
 
• **When Breath Becomes Air** is a non-fiction autobiographical book **written by American neurosurgeon Paul Kalanithi.**
 
• It is a memoir about his life and illness, battling stage IV metastatic lung cancer.
 
• It was posthumously
 
• on **January 12, 2016.**

**Bill Browder**

 
• **William Felix Browder** is an **American-born British financier and political activist.**
 
• He is the **CEO and co-founder of Hermitage Capital Management**, the investment advisor to the Hermitage Fund, which at one time was the largest foreign portfolio investor in Russia.
 
• Books written by him are **A True Story of Money Laundering, Murder, and Surviving Vladimir Putin's Wrath.**
